name: Above Below MA
summary: This EA trades based on price position relative to a Moving Average line. It enters long when price is above the MA and short when price is below the MA, following the trend direction indicated by the moving average.
summary_zh: 该EA基于价格与均线的关系进行交易。当价格在均线上方时做多，当价格在均线下方时做空，跟随均线指示的趋势方向。
strategy_analysis: 该策略属于趋势跟踪类型，核心概念是利用移动平均线作为趋势判断基准。入场条件为价格突破并维持在均线之上时做多，价格跌破并维持在均线之下时做空。出场条件可能依赖反向穿越均线或固定止损止盈。仓位管理方面，从文件名无法确定是否使用了动态仓位调整，可能仅使用固定手数。资金管理方面缺乏详细信息，但此类单一指标策略通常风险控制较为简单。该策略的弱点在于震荡行情中会频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is a trend-following type where the core concept uses a Moving Average as the trend determination benchmark. Entry conditions are going long when price breaks above and stays above the MA, and going short when price breaks below and stays below the MA. Exit conditions likely rely on price crossing back across the MA or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing details cannot be determined from the filename alone, but it likely uses fixed lot sizes. Money management details are insufficient, as single-indicator strategies typically employ simple risk controls. The strategy's weakness is that it generates frequent false signals during ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 逻辑简单直观，易于理解和维护
趋势行情中能较好地捕捉方向性利润
单一指标策略参数少，不易过拟合
pros_en: Simple and intuitive logic, easy to understand and maintain
Captures directional profits well in trending markets
Single-indicator strategy with few parameters, less prone to overfitting
cons: 单一均线信号在震荡市中频繁亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认，容易受假突破影响
无法确定是否有止损机制，风险控制可能不足
cons_en: Single MA signal leads to frequent losses in ranging markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, susceptible to false breakouts
Cannot confirm stop-loss mechanism, risk management may be insufficient
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认或过滤震荡行情的机制
加入ATR动态止损止盈以适应市场波动性
增加成交量或其他指标作为辅助确认
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation or ranging market filter mechanism
Incorporate ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit to adapt to market volatility
Add volume or other indicators as supplementary confirmation

risk_points: 单一指标策略在震荡市中风险较大
无法确认是否有止损和仓位检查机制
risk_points_en: Single indicator strategy poses significant risk in ranging markets
Cannot confirm existence of stop-loss and position check mechanisms
